plugin.name: L.A. Rush Fusion Fix
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause driving while another window is active.
GamepadIcons.description: Choose the controller button names shown on the joystick bindings screen. Auto uses Xbox names.
ResX.description: Output width in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
ResY.description: Output height in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the publisher, studio and technology logo videos and the legal screen. The intro movie stays. Takes effect when the game starts.
SkipPressStart.description: Plays the intro movie, then continues past the title prompt. Takes effect when the game starts.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original fits the whole video inside the original 4:3 presentation. Fill preserves the picture and skips the intro's encoded black borders.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen uses the chosen resolution. Windowed keeps an exact picture area at that resolution. Borderless covers the monitor at its desktop resolution. Restart the game to apply.
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the focused game window while the game hides it. Releases it in menus with a visible cursor, on focus loss, or when disabled.
FPSLimitMenus.description: Adds a menu frame limit. 0 disables the added limit without changing the game’s own timing. Values from 1 to 29 use 30.
FOVFactor.description: Adjusts the driving camera view. Scripted and special views keep their original framing.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto keeps the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape.
CheckForUpdates.description: Checks for a newer fix when enabled. A notice appears at the main menu. FusionFixHub opens the update page after the game exits, when installed beside the game. Disabled by default.
update.availablehub: A new {name} version is available. Update it in FusionFixHub after closing the game.
update.availablesite: A new {name} version is available at fusionfix.io.
CutsceneBorders.description: Preserves the original story camera framing with side borders. Off shows a wider view. Applies immediately.
